title: Keep My XP Advanced!
body:
1. "Keep My XP" (Configurable %) is a Minecraft Datapack that:
1. ✅ Keeps player XP on death
1. ⚙️ Allows configuration to keep 100% (default) or a custom % of XP
1. 🧠 Automatically restores XP after respawn
1. 🧩 Uses a simple scoreboard-based config system
1. No more losing everything… unless you want to 😉!
1. Fully multiplayer compatible.

**_I'm aware of the plugin being broken atm._**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

⚠️ Explanation:
We use scoreboard math to allow scaling XP by a percentage

</details>




✨ Features
🔹 Configurable XP Retention

Choose how much XP players keep on death:
100% (default)
75%
50%
25%

🔹 Clickable Chat Configuration Menu
Run:
~~/function keepxp:menu~~

### _doesn't work yet_

- You’ll get a clean clickable interface in chat:
- 
- [ Keep 100% ]
- [ Keep 75% ]
- [ Keep 50% ]
- [ Keep 25% ]
- 
- Clicking a button instantly updates the setting.
- No typing long scoreboard commands required.

📌 Install Instructions
Put the ZIP inside your save's instance folder:

```
.minecraft/saves/YOUR_WORLD/datapacks/Keep My XP Advanced (1.21.11).zip
```
